column1: # Jakarta EE / Java EE deployment descriptor counters (web.xml, web-fragment.xml, ejb-jar.xml,
# application.xml, the vendor descriptors that reuse these elements): the counters of xml-facts, its
# [ignore] line included, then one per descriptor element, with or without a namespace prefix.
# "session beans" counts every <session> of ejb-jar.xml (stateless, stateful and singleton), and
# "stateless session beans" the ones whose <session-type> says so; "EAR modules" every <module> of
# application.xml. A <session> of another vocabulary (a vendor's session configuration) counts too.
# EnterpriseXmlFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern
